title: keel seat result
description: A seat's result (result.json), returned on its submit channel and passed to the runtime's schema flag inline or by path per descriptor. The submit gate checks the schema and the BR echo, then recompiles the brief.
$comment: Authored in the OpenAI strict subset (every property required, additionalProperties false, null unions instead of optional fields); scripts/validate.mjs lints it. Before passing it to a runtime flag the dispatcher bundles the $refs and strips $schema, $id, $comment, title and x-keel-* annotations.

goal_echo.description: The goal this work serves, restated.

rulings.description: Rulings made inside the decision boundaries.

questions.description: Open questions; needed when status is NEEDS_CONTEXT.

blocker.description: Why the seat is blocked when status is BLOCKED, else null.

files.description: The proposal files a product, architect or planner seat authored (intent.md, spec.delta.yaml, answer.md, arch.delta.yaml, decisions/ADR-*.md, plan.yaml, workorders/T<n>.yaml), with their full contents. These seats run in read-only modes, so the Steward checks each path against the seat's writable globs, writes the bytes into the planning worktree and commits them. Empty for the engineer, whose changes are in its task worktree.

ruling.description: A ruling (keel api rule). One outside the decision boundaries, or on a stop class, is flagged to the Board.

clause.description: Id of the clause the ruling interprets.

cost.description: Cost if the ruling is wrong; receipts list rulings by cost.

handoff.description: Handoff notes for the next seat and the receipt.

not_tested.description: What was not tested; each entry becomes a Not-tested trailer.
